extras: UI is currently in Chinese; works with any AI tool that reads local files.
intentEvidence: MD Annotator is an Obsidian plugin for reviewing AI-written drafts.
motivation: The author wanted a way to communicate modification suggestions to AI with minimum cost and maximum accuracy, similar to reviewing a colleague's document.
problem: Manually describing revisions to AI-generated drafts in a chat interface is slow, ambiguous, and inefficient.
summary: MD Annotator allows users to select text in a Markdown document and attach comments using CriticMarkup syntax, enabling AI tools to process specific revisions.
